name: useEmbeddings
summary: On-device vector embeddings and semantic cosine similarity scoring via Tensor EdgeTPU.
plain: Converts text strings into dense 512-dimensional vector embeddings locally on the EdgeTPU for fast offline semantic search, deduplication, and RAG memory without server calls.
description: Executes on-device text embedding generation on the Google Tensor EdgeTPU / NPU through ML Kit GenAI. Produces normalized 512-dimensional floating point vectors from input text in milliseconds. Includes an in-memory cosine similarity calculation helper to compare semantic proximity between vectors entirely offline.

returns.name: isAvailable
returns.desc: Whether the on-device text embedding model is installed and ready for inference.

returns.name: isLoading
returns.desc: Whether an embedding inference operation is actively computing on the NPU/TPU.

returns.name: vectorDimension
returns.desc: Dimension size of the output embedding vector (512).

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if embedding inference failed.

returns.name: embed
returns.desc: Computes a normalized float vector embedding for the provided text.

returns.name: cosineSimilarity
returns.desc: Computes cosine similarity between two float vectors (-1.0 to 1.0).

actions.name: embed(text)
actions.desc: Generates a 512-dimensional embedding vector from input text.

actions.name: cosineSimilarity(vecA, vecB)
actions.desc: Scores cosine similarity between two embedding vectors.

agentNote: Exported from '@pixelkit-labs/sdk/mlkit'. Operates entirely on-device with zero network latency.
